correctness.rationale: The support of the signed-antichain polytope obeys an exact max-versus-child-sum recursion. An expectation telescoping identity and leaf domination imply a summable positive series with certified tail M b^(-h) rho^(b^(h+1))/(b-1). Monotone coupling gives strict branching order. Gaussian radial factorization yields exact mean width; Poincare concentration yields convergence of random widths; exponential Markov plus a node union bound yields the near-leaf localization. The standalone exact brute-force checker reproduced 158 support cases; finite tests are corroborative, not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Mean width is a natural canonical Euclidean invariant of the entire infinite regular-tree enriched-polytope family. The strict b-dependent excess relative to the leaf cube is not an immediate consequence of antichain cardinalities or existing deterministic radii. Certified superexponential evaluation of its limiting constants and O(log log n) exposure localization give quantitatively useful geometric information about which vertices are typically exposed.
